findings.detail: README installation commands clone pinkforest/threejs-playground, not CloudAI-X/threejs-skills
README documents .claude/skills layout; actual tree layout is skills/<name>/SKILL.md
MIT declared in README but no LICENSE file in pinned tree; GitHub API license: null
threejs-postprocessing WebGPU example uses new THREE.PostProcessing(renderer) which does not exist in the THREE namespace

Direct installation (npx skills add, npm install, copying into packages) is not approved
